exact_operator_definitions.signs: d=x_i-x_j,r=-d,dp=p_i-p_j,g=grad_iW_ij=d*actual project float WendlandFac(float(r2)); gi=Ci*g. Gp=sum Vj*(pj-pi)*gi and GJ=sum Vj*(Jj-Ji)*gi always use receiver Ci and the STORED test pressure, including its float quantization when selected.
exact_operator_definitions.C: Ci=inverse(sum_j Vj*r_ji tensor grad_iW_ij), with the same radial-kernel XZ moment construction/inversion as the retained r4 helper and production. Report moment/condition guards; every used neighbor Cj is built with its own current-V support.
exact_operator_definitions.choice_receiver: receiver_C_r2: gj=gi,den=r2,w=Vj*d.dot(gi+gi)/r2=2Vj*d.dot(gi)/r2. Normalized Eq25 2D pressure-weight trace under explicit common gamma1 convention, not a complete printed-rate reproduction.
exact_operator_definitions.choice_production: production_pair_C_Eta2: gj=Cj*g,den=r2+Eta2,w=Vj*d.dot(gi+gj)/den. Its Eq25-pattern partner is a deliberately ADAPTED/HYBRID coefficient experiment, not literal paper Eq25.
exact_operator_definitions.scalar_base: Lp=sum w*dp,Lx=sum w*d,Lstar=Lp-Gp.dot(Lx). Gk=alpha*ki*GJ for the variable law, exact zero for constant-law OFF.
exact_operator_definitions.product_rule: S_product=ki*Lstar+Gk.dot(Gp), matching the normalized pressure-only production product-rule expression at this frozen state.
exact_operator_definitions.Eq25_weight_pattern: S_pair=sum kbar_ij*w*dp - ki*Gp.dot(Lx),kbar=(ki+kj)/2. RECEIVER ki multiplies the unweighted gradient defect. Never globally pair-weight the whole Taylor defect, and never relabel ki*Lstar alone as the variable-coefficient operator.
exact_operator_definitions.independent_trace_identity: Compute raw=sum Vj*kbar*(pj-pi)*(Dxx+Dzz)*F and defect=sum Vj*r*(Dxx+Dzz)*F independently; direct=raw-ki*Gp.dot(defect). F=r.dot(gi)/r2 for receiver branch, or r.dot((gi+gj)/2)/(r2+Eta2) for adapted branch. Dxx,Dxz,Dzz ALWAYS use bare r2; traceD=2 in2D. The resulting scalar/direct agreement is an arithmetic identity, not continuum validation.

manufactured_truth_and_precision: Reuse eight retained fields1,x,z,x²/2,xz,z²/2,cos(2pi x),cos(2pi(x+z)). Analytic div(k gradp)=ki*trace(Hp)+gradk.dot(analytic gradp), with gradk=alpha*ki*(1/32,1/64) for affine-J ON and zero for uniform/constant law. Original double pressure and separately float-quantized pressure are tested; analytic p derivatives are comparison references only, never inserted into Gp. Affine pressure with variable k normally has NONZERO div(k gradp); no affine null gate is applied there. Constant pressure has exact zero source for every law/branch/method.
